delivery_total.source: Kobas Daily Headline Revenue Report (All Venues) -> Script Raw Data sheet, Delivery column (Deliverect lines, all platforms incl. HungryPanda, gross incl. VAT), via the Auto Cash Up dailies
delivery_total.basis: sum of daily delivery GBP Mon-Sun; orders = Deliveroo Daily Master (Deliveroo only)

labour_split.source: Mona Lisa 'Input Tabs' actual FOH/BOH block (pipe 1).
labour_split.note: 'absent' = the site filed no actual FOH/BOH split on any trading day of the week - NOT a failed validation and NOT a zero. 'filed' = it filed something; this pipe does not reconstruct or validate the split (rows are shifted in that tab), so 'filed' is not a validated 'ok'.

efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: Snoopy
negative_reviews.text:
Chilled atmosphere
Attentive friendly staff welcoming
Nice interior
Food was good although not the best tasting chicken karrage ramen not quite enough flavour but perhaps just not the best menu option !
Tiger roll was nice although had a belly ache after eating

negative_reviews.author: Paul Fisher
negative_reviews.text:
It was going to be a more positive review until.......
Sat gown after thr waiter banged thr drum (happens each time people enter) took my order the prawns and squid were on but a tad greasy. The prawns were borderline cooked.
Sadly the Kimchi arrived after I had finished my mains so rejected it.
Was planning to order Mochi but not after thr failures.

reviews.source: Google Reviews workbook 1aFGfbGr... 'Raw Data' tab (gid 284143046), full-history rows deduped on reviewId, filtered by review RECEIVED date to 2026-10-26..2026-11-01 (Mon-Sun). Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source). Cumulative venue rating not in this source (null). Built 2026-11-03.
